angle: Frame 0: an empty room with a big trunk peeking in + hook. Why: image models link words to things; 'no elephant' still contains 'elephant', so the word pulls one in. Fix: describe what you want ('an empty room'). Loop: 'Now: draw a room with no elephant.'
hook: Draw a room with no elephant.
strengths: Frame-0 puzzle the viewer can answer or check (week-3 brief rule); loopable ending
weaknesses: Newer models often pass; run our own test and say what happened.
